mapper.select: SELECT s.system_id AS systemId, s.system_code AS systemCode, s.system_name AS systemName, s.system_name_en AS systemNameEn, s.icon, s.color, s.category, s.sort_order AS sortOrder, us.role FROM m_system s INNER JOIN m_user_system us ON s.system_id = us.system_id WHERE us.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.sort_order
